name: Tirth Plastic Ltd.
summary: Tirth Plastic Ltd. specializes in the production and sale of acrylic solid surfaces, adhesives, and associated materials. The company further engages in both domestic and international trade of a wide array of plastic commodities, including items like plastic bags, PVC piping, and acrylic solid surface sheets. Founded on September 29, 1986, its main operational base is located in Ahmedabad, India.
